data.body: **[P2] Preserve valid null values in preview metadata.** `Map.copyOf` rejects null values, but the built-in preview generator emits null for visible nullable JSON fields. Thus `INCLUDE_ALL` or explicitly including such a field makes filesystem offloading fail before publication, and valid v1 envelopes from other producers cannot be decoded. Use an immutable defensive copy that permits JSON null values (including nested collections), and add a nullable-preview round-trip test.
